import re
from collections import Counter
documents = DATA
tokenized_documents = [re.findall(r'[a-z]+', doc.lower()) for doc in documents]
all_tokens = [token for sublist in tokenized_documents for token in sublist]
document_count = len(documents)
token_count = len(all_tokens)
unique_tokens = len(set(all_tokens))
frequencies = dict(Counter(all_tokens))
sorted_frequencies = sorted(frequencies.items(), key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))
top_tokens = [{'token': token, 'count': count} for token, count in sorted_frequencies[:3]]
print(json.dumps({'document_count': document_count, 'token_count': token_count, 'unique_tokens': unique_tokens, 'frequencies': frequencies, 'top_tokens': top_tokens}))
